title: Residential Electricity Supply Referral Credits: Seasoned Referrer Bonus
content:
**Rule.** When the referring Residential Electricity Supply agreement carries 12 or more energy charge lines, the seasoned-referrer bonus of 5.00 USD is added to the referral credit; when it carries 3 to 11, the settling-referrer bonus of 3.00 USD is added; when it carries fewer than 3, nothing is added.

**What is counted.** Every energy charge line on the referring agreement's bills, whenever posted. Monthly service fee lines and credit lines are not energy charge lines. On a time-of-use agreement the on-peak line and the off-peak line of a cycle are two energy charge lines.

| Energy charge lines on the referring agreement | Seasoned referrer bonus |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 5.00 USD |
| 3 to 11 | 3.00 USD |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

**Boundaries.** 12 lines take 5.00 USD and 11 lines take 3.00 USD; 3 lines take 3.00 USD and 2 lines take nothing.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 referrer with 7 billed cycles carries 14 energy charge lines (an on-peak and an off-peak line for each cycle) and adds 5.00 USD; a flat-rate referrer with 7 billed cycles carries 7 lines and adds 3.00 USD.
